no_adcom_quote.quote: Your application for Ojemda was not referred to an FDA advisory committee because the application did not raise significant safety or efficacy issues that were unexpected in the intended population.

summary: No FDA advisory committee was convened for OJEMDA (tovorafenib, NDA 218033). The original approval letter states the application was not referred to an advisory committee because it did not raise significant safety or efficacy issues that were unexpected in the intended population. Note that only labels and approval letters are available in paperclip for this NDA; no multidisciplinary review documents were present to review, but the approval letter definitively establishes that no AdComm meeting occurred, so there are no AdComm-driven linkages to the approval.
